Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Consolidated change order proposal: add capacity + fee alignment

Sofia,

Thanks again for the quick demo last week. As we discussed with the engineering team, ClearWave needs to accelerate usage of the Redwood inference pool for our new realtime triage feature. Attached is a proposed change order that does three things:
- Add 150 reserved throughput units (committed capacity) starting 2027-10-01
- Apply the negotiated volume discount to the additional units (line item B)
- Shorten the implementation SLA window from 45 to 30 days (we need faster ramp)

We attached the proposal (ClearWave_CO_v1.pdf) and the Q2 usage report so you can validate current baseline. We're hoping to get a redlined Order Form back by EOD Thursday so procurement can route for signature next week.

Are there any blocking legal items on Redwood's side (e.g., payment terms or rollback protections) that would slow this? If you prefer, loop in whoever owns amendments on your side.

Thanks,
Alex Gordon
Head of Platform Integrations
ClearWave Health
